bench_mps_load_file: bench a safetensors file on MPS device comparing slow safe_open and fast MPSBulkLoad throughput
create_llm_model: create an LLM model state dict with a target size in GB for benchmarking safetensors loads
save_file_tensors: save a dictionary of PyTorch tensors to a safetensors file for benchmark loading
load_file_mps_device: load a safetensors file directly onto the MPS device for performance benchmarking
run_bench_cli: run the MPS load benchmark CLI with a safetensors file path and iteration count
